```{python}
#| label: fig-gbwp-feedback
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Magnitude response of a first-order system in open loop and with frequency-independent feedback $G$. Dots mark the $-3\\,\\text{dB}$ cut-off frequencies, crosses the unity-gain frequencies."
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

db = lambda x: 20 * np.log10(np.abs(x))

A = 1e3       # open-loop dc gain
fc = 1e5      # open-loop cut-off frequency (Hz)
fT = A * fc   # open-loop transit frequency = GBWP
f = np.logspace(3, 10, 1000)
H_ol = A / (1 + 1j * f / fc)

plt.semilogx(f, db(fT / f), linestyle='--', color='gray', zorder=3, label="GBWP asymptote $f_\\mathrm{T,ol}/f$")
plt.semilogx(f, db(H_ol), color='k', label="open loop")
for G, col in [(0.01, 'b'), (0.9, 'g'), (1.0, 'r')]:
    H_cl = H_ol / (1 + H_ol * G)
    H0 = A / (1 + A * G)
    fc_cl = fc * (1 + A * G)
    plt.semilogx(f, db(H_cl), color=col, label=f"closed loop, $G = {G:g}$")
    plt.plot(fc_cl, db(H0 / np.sqrt(2)), 'o', color=col)
    if H0 > 1:
        plt.plot(fc_cl * np.sqrt(H0**2 - 1), 0, 'x', color=col, markersize=9, mew=2)
plt.plot(fc, db(A / np.sqrt(2)), 'o', color='k')
plt.plot(fT, 0, 'x', color='k', markersize=9, mew=2)
plt.axhline(0, color='gray', linewidth=0.8)
plt.ylim(-40, 70)
plt.xlim(f[0], f[-1])
plt.xlabel(r"$f$ (Hz)")
plt.ylabel(r"$|H(f)|$ (dB)")
plt.legend(loc='lower left')
plt.grid(True, which='both', alpha=0.3)
```
